mapper.select: SELECT content FROM public.mm_asset_text WHERE asset_id = #{assetId} ORDER BY seq_no ASC, created_at ASC
SELECT tg.tag_name FROM public.mm_asset_tag atg JOIN public.mm_tag tg ON tg.tag_id = atg.tag_id WHERE atg.asset_id = #{assetId} ORDER BY tg.tag_name ASC
SELECT c.category_name FROM public.mm_asset_category ac JOIN public.mm_category c ON c.category_id = ac.category_id WHERE ac.asset_id = #{assetId} ORDER BY c.category_name ASC

SELECT d.space_id FROM public.mm_asset a JOIN public.mm_dataset_version dv ON dv.version_id = a.dataset_version_id JOIN public.mm_dataset d ON d.dataset_id = dv.dataset_id WHERE a.asset_id = #{assetId}

SELECT d.dataset_id FROM public.mm_asset a JOIN public.mm_dataset_version dv ON dv.version_id = a.dataset_version_id JOIN public.mm_dataset d ON d.dataset_id = dv.dataset_id WHERE a.asset_id = #{assetId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.mm_asset_tag (asset_id, tag_id, source_type) VALUES (#{assetId}, #{tagId}, #{sourceType}) ON CONFLICT (asset_id, tag_id) DO UPDATE SET source_type = EXCLUDED.source_type

INSERT INTO public.mm_asset_category (asset_id, category_id, source_type) VALUES (#{assetId}, #{categoryId}, #{sourceType}) ON CONFLICT (asset_id, category_id) DO UPDATE SET source_type = EXCLUDED.source_type

INSERT INTO public.mm_asset ( asset_id, dataset_version_id, file_id, asset_type, logical_path, file_name, source_asset_code, sha256, size_bytes, content_type, width, height, status, meta ) VALUES
( #{item.assetId}, #{item.datasetVersionId}, #{item.fileId}, #{item.assetType}, #{item.logicalPath}, #{item.fileName}, #{item.sourceAssetCode}, #{item.sha256}, #{item.sizeBytes}, #{item.contentType}, #{item.width}, #{item.height}, #{item.status}, #{item.meta, typeHandler=com.fwdrobo.sirius.handler.JsonbTypeHandler} )
ON CONFLICT (dataset_version_id, logical_path) DO UPDATE SET file_id = EXCLUDED.file_id, file_name = EXCLUDED.file_name, source_asset_code = EXCLUDED.source_asset_code, size_bytes = EXCLUDED.size_bytes, content_type = EXCLUDED.content_type, width = EXCLUDED.width, height = EXCLUDED.height, status = EXCLUDED.status, meta = EXCLUDED.meta
